remarks: Welcome to sophisticated, resort-style living at 85 Camp Avenue! This stunning 2-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom townhouse-style condo, built in 2007, offers an expansive 1,925 square feet of modern, light-filled space complemented by fantastic community amenities. As you enter, you'll immediately appreciate the thoughtful layout and contemporary design. The open-concept main level flows seamlessly, creating an ideal environment for both relaxing and entertaining. The kitchen has been recently enhanced with a custom-built pantry and a chic coffee bar, adding both style and valuable storage. Upstairs, the private quarters include two generous bedrooms. The primary suite is a true retreat, featuring a spacious layout and a beautifully updated en-suite bathroom with a new vanity and modern lighting. A major highlight of this unit is the versatile upper-level loft-a perfect flexible space for a home office, media room, or guest room. You'll find a dedicated laundry room on the lower level w/ tons of storage space, as well as the convenience of a one-car attached garage.  Beyond your front door, the community offers an exceptional lifestyle. Residents enjoy access to an in-ground swimming pool, a pool house, and a well-equipped fitness center. Located in the highly convenient Springdale location of Stamford, you are just moments away from the Merritt Parkway and a fantastic array of shopping and restaurants.
